what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sri Lanka in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12815 Sri Lankan asylum seekers in Canada, 38.2% of all asylum seekers from Sri Lanka.
Refugees from Sri Lanka, a separate group, live mostly in India, France, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka from 1995 to 2001, in 2003 and from 2005 to 2009, with the LTTE, at war level in many of those years.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Sri Lanka after 2009, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew in recent years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 2192 asylum seekers, and the figure fell to a low in 2014.
It then rose again, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
